brief_text:
I need to decide how best to split my attention as the main founder working on Olumi at the moment.
I urgently need to secure funding: both fast-paced angel and, eventually, a larger fund of at least 1.3 million.
I need to complete the PoC. I have AI working on it, so I don't need to be on it all of the time, but the more time I spend testing and improving it, the better it is.
I need to put job specs out for the resource we need.

I need to determine what I should prioritise and how I should spend my time across these.
